about: Controls stop pulsing and shimmering with the music.
The waveform draws fewer things at once.
why_not: The layers on the waveform are yours. §79 lets you lock the interface out of changing them, so djmanzo drops the answering rather than the layers: the strip stops reacting to the audio and still draws everything you asked for.

about: The room is read less often — every eight seconds instead of two.
Artwork and waveform overviews are drawn on demand.
why_not: djmanzo has no expensive previews to stop drawing. The overview is a cached tile and the artwork is whatever the file already carried.

about: Glow, chromatic aberration and blend modes come off.
The camera's optical flow stops being computed every tick.
Never. The sound is what the other six are spent on.
why_not: The audio thread never allocates, locks or does I/O, and nothing the interface decides can reach it. There is no tier at which djmanzo spends the sound on the screen.
